description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Druids' Repository.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Druids' Repository by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Druids' Repository
uses.cardState: with a charge counter on it
